chain.label: Tailwind on approach to runway 8
chain.trigger: captain noted a 20-knot tailwind indication on the FMS screen; tower reported wind 210 at 6

chain.label: Controller retained high-speed restriction, issued close-in vector, and gave ambiguous crossing restriction
chain.trigger: "maintain two thirty or greater 'til advised"; "cross Van Nuys at or above three thousand, cleared visual approach runway eight"

chain.label: Captain delayed reducing airspeed and configuring the airplane
chain.trigger: flight crew did not extend the speed brakes or flaps until about 1809, more than 1 minute after the approach clearance was issued

caused_by.evidence: having to keep his speed up (to 230 knots) and the tailwind contributed to the fast approach
Canceling the speed adjustment would have permitted the accident captain to begin to reduce his speed about 37 seconds sooner, thereby giving him more time to properly execute his approach

chain.label: First officer omitted required deviation and altitude callouts
chain.trigger: the first officer did not call out airspeed or sink rate deviations to the captain; no altitude callouts were recorded by the CVR

chain.label: Flight crew continued an unstabilized approach without performing a go-around
chain.trigger: he became "fixated on the runway," and he could not explain why he did not perform a go-around maneuver

caused_by.evidence: The captain's delay in reducing airspeed and configuring the airplane caused the flight crew to initiate final descent at a higher altitude and a faster airspeed than normal, contributing to the unstabilized approach

if the first officer had made the airspeed and sink rate deviation callouts or altitude callouts, both the captain and the first officer might have been further alerted to the fact that the airplane's airspeed and sink rate were excessive
the actions of the SCT Woodland controller positioned the airplane too fast, too high, and too close to the runway threshold to leave any safe options other than a go-around maneuver

chain.label: Wet runway 8
chain.trigger: Runway 8 was wet at the time of the accident

chain.label: Inadequate runway safety area with blast fence close to runway 8 departure end
chain.trigger: no significant longitudinal RSA exists on the departure end of runway 8. A metal blast fence is located 32 feet from the departure end of runway 8

chain.label: Airplane touched down long and fast and overran runway 8
chain.trigger: airplane touched down at 182 knots about 2,150 feet beyond the runway 8 threshold, 44 knots over reference speed

caused_by.evidence: the flight crew landed the airplane at an excessive airspeed; the accident airplane landed about 2,150 feet from the runway 8 threshold, further indicating that the airplane was not in the proper position to land
the accident airplane would have required about 4,700 feet of runway length after touchdown to stop using maximum manual brakes [under wet runway conditions]

chain.label: Airplane collided with blast fence and perimeter wall
chain.trigger: the airplane departed the right side of the runway... penetrated a metal blast fence and an airport perimeter wall

caused_by.evidence: the airplane... penetrated a metal blast fence and an airport perimeter wall and came to a stop on a city street
A metal blast fence is located 32 feet from the departure end of runway 8

chain.label: Passenger and crew injuries
chain.trigger: 2 passengers sustained serious injuries; 41 passengers and the captain sustained minor injuries

caused_by.evidence: 2 passengers sustained serious injuries; 41 passengers and the captain sustained minor injuries
